item.title: Markavion Johnson-Smith signs with Allen University - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: Bainbridge High School senior Markavion Johnson-Smith has officially signed to continue his football career and education at Allen University.

item.title: Bainbridge hair stylist warns of Facebook scam - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: If you see a Facebook post by someone claiming to work for Acheivers Salon LLC, Carolyn Cheatem has a warning for you.

item.title: Decatur County Schools hiring bus drivers amid shortage - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: The district is experiencing a shortage of bus drivers that could impact bus routes and student pick-up and drop-off times.

item.title: Bainbridge soccer mercy-rules opponents on senior night - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: The Bainbridge High School soccer teams celebrated their senior nights Thursday with two big mercy-rule victories — the Bearcats took down Westover 11-1 and the Lady Cats handled Westover 10-0.

item.title: Federal funds to help Attapulgus replace asbestos-cement pipes - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: The City of Attapulgus will receive federal funding to replace some of the asbestos-cement pipe currently used in its water mains, Mayor Art King announced at Tuesday’s city council meeting.

item.title: Acclaimed author Skip Horack to visit Bainbridge - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: The award-winning writer and educator Skip Horack will speak at the Kirbo Center at ABAC Bainbridge on Tuesday, March 31, at 7 p.m.

item.title: Bass Cats qualify for Tennessee championship - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: Enfinger and Kennedy competed against 160 other teams on Lake Sam Rayburn in Texas earlier this month.

item.title: Lady Cats win tight tennis matchup - The Post-Searchlight
item.description: The senior trio of Caroline Maxwell, Alyssa Jackson, and Gibbs Palmer got it done for the Lady Cats against Seminole County High School, helping the team secure the 3-2 win Thursday. The Bearcats lost 1-4 but were able to secure the lone point from Hudson Wilemon.
